objective: Test whether hierarchical aspect-then-sentiment decisions improve the existing candidate-pair system without new transformer fine-tuning.

included: B: zero-retraining hierarchical decoding of existing final seen-validation pair scores for all five registered methods
C: genuine no-transformer-fine-tuning two-stage scoring for strict TF-IDF, frozen E5-base-v2, and frozen Qwen
deferred: D: open-set unknown-aspect anomaly detection and conditional sentiment

data_contract.training_filter: remove every official training row containing the fold's held-out aspect
data_contract.selection_rule: thresholds use seen-aspect validation evidence only; held-out validation evidence is evaluation-only

study_B.source: immutable final L2 seen-calibration validation score shards referenced by each threshold-transfer artifact
study_B.baseline_decoder: select every aspect-sentiment pair whose score meets the cross-fitted pair threshold

hierarchical_decoder.aspect_score: maximum of the three existing sentiment-specific pair scores
hierarchical_decoder.aspect_selection: aspect_score meets the cross-fitted aspect threshold
hierarchical_decoder.sentiment_selection: argmax over negative, neutral, positive for each selected aspect

study_B.interpretation_boundary: in-distribution seen-aspect decoder diagnostic; it does not estimate held-out taxonomy generalisation

tfidf.model: balanced logistic regression over four aspect-only lexical interaction features fitted on the filtered train fold

stage_1.e5: frozen cosine similarity between review and aspect-only candidate text

stage_2.target: conditional sentiment for an aspect selected by stage 1

tfidf.model: existing six-feature unified TF-IDF scorer fitted only on present seen aspects with wrong-sentiment negatives

stage_2.e5: argmax frozen similarity over three sentiment-conditioned claims

frozen_qwen.model: argmax frozen next-token logits over three locked single-token sentiment verbalizers

study_C.aspect_threshold_objective: end-to-end pair_micro_f1 on seen-aspect validation evidence

multi_sentiment_policy.primary: retain all rows and evaluate the supervisor-style single-sentiment argmax decoder unchanged
multi_sentiment_policy.sensitivity: also report results restricted to aspect instances with exactly one gold sentiment

tracked_outputs: small aggregate summaries without review text

stop_conditions: missing or hash-incompatible source score shards
